newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-STEAUA BUCHAREST V BORUSSIA DORTMUND TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STEAUA BUCHAREST V BORUSSIA DORTMUND TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup match between Steaua Bucharest of Romania and Borussia Dortmund of Germany in group B of the Champions' League:

Steaua Bucharest: 12-Daniel Gherasim; 4-Tiberiu Csik, 6-Daniel Prodan, 3-Roland Nagy; 22-Denias Serban, 5-Bogdan Bucur, 8-Damian Militaru, 2-Iulian Filipescu, 11-Sabin Ilie; 7-Marius Lacatus, 9-Augustin Calin.

Borussia Dortmund: 1-Stefan Klos; 15-Juergen Kohler, 7-Stefan Reuter, 5-Julio Cesar, 20-Wolfgang Feiersinger, 17-Joerg Heinrich; 14-Paul Lambert, 10-Andreas Moeller, 8-Michael Zorc; 11-Heiko Herrlich, 18-Lars Ricken.
